# thoth_tool_inventory (Data Source)

The workspace's tools with Thoth's advisory recommendation for each: risk flags, a risk level, suggested action classes, a suggested decision (STEP_UP or BLOCK; ALLOW only for a tool an admin declared read), the reasons, and a draft policy rule. It recommends from names, schemas and observed decisions, which are untrusted; it writes no class, rule or decision. Declare classes with thoth_tool_classification and commit rules through the previewed policy flow. Recommendations need an admin credential.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `needs_classification` (Boolean) True: only tools with no declared class yet. False: only declared tools. Unset: all.
- `server` (String) Only tools whose name is mcp__<server>__<tool> for this server.

### Read-Only

- `data_json` (String) Tools as a JSON array of {tool_name, source, agent_ids, first_seen, last_seen, confirmation_status, confirmed_classes, proposed_classes, observed, recommendation}. A tool's reported description, input schema and annotations are left out, since a tool author wrote them.
- `note` (String) The server's note on what the recommendations are.
- `recommendations_available` (Boolean) False when the credential is not an admin's, so tools carry no recommendation.
- `total` (Number) Number of tools returned.
